title: Planned film tests of telepathy and of communication over the Hill

tellings.quote: be having two or three uh non-speakers in different locations to communicate together um via the hill

plain: In 2025 a filmmaker named Ky Dickens, who made a documentary series about children said to read minds, was planning filmed tests of telepathy. She tells Michels the idea was to put two or three non-speakers, people who cannot talk, in different places and have them communicate through what they call 'the Hill', a place they describe meeting in their minds. If it worked on camera, it would be evidence that minds can share thoughts directly.
